newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold completes $48 mln Mali bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Randgold completes $48 mln Mali bond issue.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Friday it had successfully completed the issue of convertible debentures to the value of $48 million.
Of the proceeds, $30 million will be capitalised into shares in subsidary Randgold Resources to help fund its acquisition of BHP Minerals Mali Inc.
Randgold commercial director Brett Kebble said the offer -- lead managed by HSBC Investment Bank Plc -- had been oversubscribed by more than 3-1/2 times, thanks to strong international support.

The bonds, which mature on October 3, 2001, are priced at par and pay a semi-annual coupon of seven percent. The conversion price of 39.01 rand is 25 percent over the 30-day average Randgold share price or 8.4 percent over the September 25 close. The shares closed at 34.25 rand on Friday.
The bonds will be listed in Luxembourg.
Randgold announced earlier this month that it had bought BHP Minerals Mali Inc from Australia's BHP Holdings Inc for $84 million.
The deal includes a 65 percent stake in Syama, one of West Africa's largest gold mines. Its estimated resources amount to 110,000 kg of gold at an in situ grade of 4.1 grams/tonne.
